github_confirmation.source: GitHub connector run/jobs queries; receipt recorded after direct inspection

evidence: Actual downloaded and ZIP-checksummed C5i artifacts; no rendering or optimizer rerun

config.psf: signed inherited Quintic effective PSF; no clipping, shift or renormalization
config.amplitude_solver: inherited scipy.optimize.nnls, one nonnegative amplitude, no ceiling
config.objective: inherited full-crop RMS-normalized squared residual; GalSim reference is not truth
config.acceptance: complete finite provenance/bookkeeping; no cross-renderer or Gaussian-recovery band
config.limitations: shared empirical PSF; no AGN/noise/shape fit; signed wings are not photon-ready
